name: Figure
summary: An image or a media frame with its caption.

guidance.useFor: Images and diagrams that the text refers to, in an article or beside a passage; a rounded frame (Media) for art.
insteadUse: A photo of a person: Avatar
An icon beside text: Icon or Icon tile
content: Alt text says what the image shows; the caption adds what it means or where it comes from
Decorative art gets empty alt; the caption still helps

rungReason: <figure> and <figcaption> associate the caption with the image natively.

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

rules: Images scale with their column and never overflow it (WCAG 1.4.10)
forcedColors: System text colours; art hides its satin
